convert.title: Format Convert
convert.tip_1: The parser is deliberately conservative. Fewer questions than the source usually means image questions or odd formatting — add them manually on the right.
convert.tip_2: After parsing, quickly check that each stem, option and answer line up, so misalignment does not affect later practice.
convert.tip_3: Native Word (.docx) and structured data (.json / .csv) import with the highest accuracy. Scanned PDFs need OCR and may contain a few misrecognized characters.
convert.help_principle_1: Missing questions are normal — just add them manually.
convert.help_principle_2: Always verify each question in the preview area.
convert.help_principle_3: The cleaner the original layout, the higher the recognition rate.
convert.help_format_3: Fallback only; image PDFs need OCR, 60-80% recognition
convert.help_faq_1: 0 questions parsed: usually wrong format — check that questions start with 1. and options with A.
convert.help_faq_2: Options mixed into the stem: option format is irregular or several options share one line — split them manually on the right.
convert.help_faq_3: Garbled PDF output: the file is a scan; install Tesseract-OCR and it will be enabled automatically.
convert.btn_reading_tip: This is for long articles (whitepapers, news). If you upload a question bank, just click Parse & Preview on the left.

privacy.title: Our Principles
privacy.c1_desc: All banks, papers, scores and wrong-question data live in a local SQLite file on your computer. Nothing is ever sent to a cloud server.
privacy.c2_desc: We do not collect your IP address, device information or usage behaviour. There is no analytics at all.
privacy.c3_desc: Even with the network cable unplugged, answering, grading, the wrong book and spaced repetition all keep working.
privacy.c4_desc: To wipe everything, delete data/quiz.db in the program folder. All your data disappears with no cloud residue.
privacy.c5_desc: AI parsing and generation call the Ollama model running on your own machine, so your documents never leave your device.
privacy.why_desc_1: ZhiJuan is a local-first tool for document conversion, paper generation and practice. Because there is no expensive cloud server, every core feature is free, with no membership limits or ads.
privacy.why_desc_2: Parsing, standard paper generation and layout all happen on your computer, so there is no upload/download latency. Typical parsing and assembly take milliseconds, and local AI needs no cloud queue. Unplug the network and you can still practise.
